name: Gwen Hooper
life: “I still remember unbuttoning a suit from the inside to save its braid.” Thursday often includes a stop at the courtyard by Ferry Street Rooms, where Gwen prefers the bench where the sound of the shop door reaches before the visitor does.
voice: I can alter the shirt but the old buttons came off his wedding suit. I want him to choose.
appearance: Gwen has two dimples that appear only with a full smile. Look for a dark undercut with a longer wave on top. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a mustard canvas overshirt with a copper-colored clasp that has been repaired by hand. In conversation Gwen leans a shoulder against the wall during long conversations.
personality: Gwen has a long memory for unfair prices and a short one for small insults. Gwen can get along perfectly well with an enemy provided the account between them is clear.
agenda: To preserve the wedding buttons unless the client chooses otherwise.
family: Chris Liu is Gwen’s cousin. Gwen makes room at the table. Chris brings whatever was actually growing or affordable that week. The meal sometimes produces a solution. Even when it does not, everyone goes away knowing what the other household is up against. Asked about *No lifeguard at dusk*, Chris says, “I know my own strength. I need to tell the young guard that sometimes I sit here without getting in.”
connections: Alex Hamm. They discuss an easier fastening without assuming an old wedding shirt is disposable.

reactions.situation: A visit runs into a second billing block
reactions.response: Gwen records the extra time actually spent with the client.

reactions.situation: Somebody says a missing friend must be avoiding their calls
reactions.response: Gwen asks what the friend actually said last time and checks whether anybody is expecting them at home.
